articles.title: Earth's Building Blocks Came from Next Door, Not the Outer Solar System
articles.summary: A new study says Earth formed almost entirely from inner-solar-system material — less than 2 percent came from beyond Jupiter. The researchers were "truly astonished."

articles.title: Great Lakes Sturgeon May Live 400+ Years, Study Suggests
articles.summary: A new study says lake sturgeon in the Great Lakes may live up to 435 years — nearly three times the previous record. One outside scientist says all sturgeon species now need a re-check.

articles.title: Orcas Are Exploding Sunfish Like Piñatas, New Footage Shows
articles.summary: New footage from the Gulf of California shows orcas ramming dead sunfish so hard they explode. Scientists think it may be to feed young orcas — or just for fun.
